# KafkaQuorumVoterUnreachable

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 5m / 30s |

**Summary:** Node <kafka_broker> cannot reach a KRaft voter

The KRaft quorum on cluster <kafka_cluster> has reduced fault tolerance: one more voter failure can stop metadata processing.

## Impact

The quorum tolerates one failure less than designed.

## Diagnosis

1. Which node reports it (label kafka_broker) and which voter is down: Kafka · KRaft → Raft role per node.

## Mitigation

- Restore the voter; check DNS/network for the controller listener.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_raftmetrics_number_unknown_voter_connections) > 0
```
